title: ArtefactTranslations
description: Sidecar translation file. One file per (locale, source) tuple. The optional `kind` field selects the artefact this sidecar translates (capability | value-stream | business-process). Default is 'capability' for back-compat with pre-VS/BP sidecars. Identifiers, levels, industry tags, references, framework refs, and lifecycle metadata stay locale-neutral in the source YAML.

kind.description: Artefact this sidecar translates. Selects which `entries` key pattern and which translatable-field set apply.

locale.description: BCP-47 language tag (e.g. 'fr', 'fr-CA', 'zh', 'pt-BR'). Must equal the parent directory name under catalogue/i18n/.

source.description: Filename of the source artefact this translates. For capabilities: 'L1-<slug>.yaml'. For business processes: 'BP1-<slug>.yaml'. For the value-stream catalogue: '_value-streams.yaml'.

entries.description: Map of artefact id -> translated display fields. Every key must resolve to a node in the source artefact. Allowed key patterns and translatable fields depend on `kind` (see allOf below).

metadata.description: Translator credits, review status, completion notes. Not consumed by build.

CapabilityFields.description: Translatable fields for a capability or business-process node. All optional — omit a field to fall back to the source language for that field only.

source_hash.description: Optional staleness marker. SHA-256 fingerprint (first 16 hex chars) of the source node's translatable surface (name, description, aliases, in_scope, out_of_scope) at the time this entry was authored or last refreshed. Lint recomputes the hash from the current source and flags a mismatch as stale (drift). Run `npm run i18n:stamp` to backfill or refresh.

ValueStreamFields.description: Translatable fields for a value-stream entry. Stream-level entries (id matching ^VS-\d+$) accept `name` and `description`; stage-level entries (id matching ^VS-\d+\.\d+$) accept `stage_name`, `description`, and `notes`.

source_hash.description: Optional staleness marker. SHA-256 fingerprint (first 16 hex chars) of the source stream/stage's translatable surface at the time this entry was authored or last refreshed. Lint recomputes the hash from the current source and flags a mismatch as stale (drift). Run `npm run i18n:stamp` to backfill or refresh.
